name: Zig
local_changes_within_upstream: src/dev.zig defines the freestanding WROS compiler profile with the Zig semantic analyzer and LLVM bitcode writer.
src/main.zig handles SDK commands and emits the complete reachable Zig module through the native frontend.
src/codegen/llvm.zig completes a bitcode-only WROS build after the native builder has written its output.

mark_mte.cpp.origin: existing SDK v2 Zig LLVM marker, from the uncommitted working tree
mark_mte.cpp.changes: Preserve original source paths emitted by the module-aware frontend and check the _start function signature.

qualification: The native compiler packages are build inputs. Independent installation, guest execution and MTE qualification are recorded separately.
